summary.text: Andrew Engell represents the 7th Legislative District in the Washington House of Representatives and lives in Colville. His official page lists him as Assistant Ranking Member of the Agriculture & Natural Resources Committee, and he also serves on the Health Care & Wellness, Housing and Transportation committees.

paragraphs.text: Engell has lived in the Colville area since early childhood, according to his official page, and has experience in welding, construction, farming and managing affordable housing units.
The page says he worked for more than seven years for former Congresswoman Cathy McMorris Rodgers.

The page lists his priorities as supporting law enforcement and public safety, opposing tax increases and burdensome regulations, parents' rights in education, the Second Amendment, forest management and wildfire response, streamlined permitting for housing, and veterans' benefits.
It says he lives in Colville with his wife, Celeste, and their four children.
